title: pr-135791-seasonal-alert-snoozer-and-shard-cost-correlator
author: Asha Nair
description: Motivation: Our alert noise during predictable daily/weekly traffic patterns (region-specific morning spikes and batch windows) causes operator fatigue and obscures real regressions. Separately, SREs wanted an easy way to correlate token-level cost anomalies with GPU shard queue pressure to find expensive hot-prompts that also stress scheduling. This PR implements two complementary observability features: (1) a Seasonality-aware Alert Snoozer (Snoozer) that automatically mutes/attenuates alerts in configured quiet windows derived from historical metric seasonality, and (2) a Shard Cost Correlator dashboard and export that links per-invocation token cost deltas with GPU-shard queueing metrics so teams can triage cost spikes that coincide with kernel contention. Scope: - Runtime agent: small windowed analyzer that emits "snoozer_candidate" telemetry when an alerting rule aligns with a learned seasonal window. - Alert manager integration: new rule annotations and an opt-in auto-snooze controller that can be configured per-tenant and per-route. - Telemetry: new metric series telemetry.snoozer.reason and taggable fields on alert events for downstream analysis. - Dashboard: Grafana dashboard (observability/grafana/shard-cost-corr.json) that joins token_cost_delta, invocation_latency_phase, and gpu_shard_queue_ms into a unified view and provides an export job for CSV correlation analysis. - Tests: unit tests for the seasonality detector, integration test for the alert controller, and a small replaybench to validate correlator outputs against synthetic spikes. Checklist: - [x] Seasonality model (exponential smoothing + weekday/daypart heuristics) - [x] Agent telemetry and annotation API - [x] Alert manager controller and permission gating - [x] Grafana dashboard and sample queries - [x] Unit + integration tests - [x] Migration docs and admin flagging UI notes Usage notes: - The Snoozer is opt-in per-tenant via console toggles; default behavior is analysis-only (alerts annotated but not muted). - Admins can define conservative quiet windows generated from the model suggestions or specify explicit overrides. - Grafana dashboard includes pre-built panels that surface top correlated invocations; CSV export available for offline analysis Rollout plan: 1) Deploy agent + telemetry (analysis-only) to staging for two weeks to collect baseline annotations. 2) Enable annotation view in Console and gather feedback from oncall. 3) Gradual opt-in for auto-snooze beginning with low-cost, high-noise alerts (30% of alerts) followed by broader coverage if no false-silences observed. Related: ENG-5421 (alert churn reduction), SUP-2138 (customer-reported noisy morning alerts), ENG-5490 (kernel queueing investigation).
commits_summary:
1) seasonality: add detector, smoothing helpers, window summarization
2) agent: emit snoozer_candidate telemetry and attach alert annotation hooks
3) alert-controller: introduce auto-snooze policy, tenant opt-in checks, audit events
4) grafana: shard-cost-correlator dashboard + export job
5) tests: unit/integration/replaybench + fixtures
6) docs: console/admin guide and runbook snippets

review_comments:
Marta Ruiz (review): Nice approach, the weekday/daypart heuristic looks stable but add a fuzz factor for timezone-anchored tenants; question on retention: how long do we keep snoozer_candidate events?
Asha (reply): Default retention is 30d; added TTL config and noted in README.
Evan Chen (review): Auto-snooze audit trail must be immutable and surfaceable in runbooks; please add structured audit events.
Asha (reply): Added audit events (controllers/alert/audit_events.go) and Console UI hooks for review/undo.
Priya Singh (review): The Grafana join looks expensive; can we pre-aggregate a daily shard-cost rollup to reduce query time?
Asha (reply): Added daily rollup job (dashboards/queries/correlator.sql) and documented the fallback.
Merge note: after two green CI reruns and manual staging smoke tests, approved by all reviewers on 2026-02-20.
ci_checks: CI: unit (pass, 4m), integration (pass, 12m), lint (pass, 1m), replaybench (pass, 6m), grafana-validate (pass, 30s); flakey: one transient infra failure on first integration run retried and passed.
release_notes: Added seasonality-based alert snoozer (opt-in) and a shard-cost correlator dashboard to link token-level cost anomalies with GPU shard queue metrics. Admins can enable analysis-only mode to preview annotations before auto-snooze. See docs/observability/snoozer_admin_guide.md for configuration and runbook steps.
testing_instructions:
1) Enable analysis-only in staging via overlays/staging/agent-config.yaml
2) Run replaybench against synthetic_spikes.py and verify snoozer_candidate events emitted
3) Open Grafana dashboard and export CSV for top correlated invocations
4) Enable opt-in auto-snooze for a low-noise alert and validate audit events are created
notes_for_ops: Default TTL for snoozer_candidate telemetry is 30 days; if you have long-running seasonal patterns (quarterly), increase retention. Auto-snooze includes an audit trail and console undo; treat auto-snooze as a conservative suppression not an incident resolution. Monitor "snoozer.false_positives" metric after rollout.
security_considerations: No PII introduced. Audit events record reference ids and tenant ids only and honor tenant RBAC. Configured auto-snooze requires tenant admin permission to enable. Documented in docs/observability/snoozer_admin_guide.md.
